anomalies.description: A large group of ice hockey players from two teams (red/white and black/orange) are engaged in a sustained on-ice brawl, with multiple individuals grappling, pushing, and shoving in a tight cluster. Referees in striped jerseys are actively intervening, attempting to separate the players. The confrontation persists across all frames, with minor shifts in positioning but continuous physical contact.

Multiple players from opposing teams (red/white and black/orange uniforms) engage in a large-scale on-ice brawl, involving punching, grappling, and shoving; referees and staff attempt to intervene throughout.

A player in red/white uniform (number 25) is on the ice, seemingly incapacitated or downed, while other players continue to strike or press down on him amid the ongoing melee, indicating targeted aggression toward a helpless individual.

Two players engage in mutual physical combat: one in a white jersey with red trim (number 88) and another in a dark jersey grapple, push, and wrestle each other near center ice, culminating in both falling to the ice.; Two players engage in a physical fight on the ice: one in black falls, then is struck and kicked by the opponent in red/white (No. 77), who lifts the fallen player’s leg in an aggressive motion (visible at f2). The fight continues with grappling and striking near the goal net.

A player in red/white (No. 77) delivers a high kick/stomp to a downed opponent lying on the ice, while the opponent is clearly unable to defend himself — meeting the definition of attacking a helpless victim.

A second fight erupts near the goal: a player in a red/white jersey (number 2) and a player in a black jersey (number 21) engage in a physical altercation, involving grappling and shoving, while officials attempt to intervene.; Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the goal and boards, involving punching, grappling, and shoving; referees intervene to separate them.

After the initial fight, multiple players from both teams converge near the goal, escalating into a multi-person scrum against the boards involving at least 6–8 individuals, including referees attempting to separate them. This constitutes collective violent unrest beyond a bilateral fight.

Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the goal, involving grappling, shoving, and attempts to strike; referees intervene but the fight persists across the sequence.; Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the goal net, involving grappling, shoving, and punching; referees and coaches intervene to separate them.

A player in red/white jersey (No. 95) appears to strike or push a downed opponent near the net while the opponent is on the ice and unable to defend, supported by referee intervention and body positioning.
Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a physical altercation near the goal net, involving grappling, pushing, and helmet-to-helmet contact; officials and coaches intervene to separate them.
A player in black jersey (No. 10) appears to strike or shove a downed or vulnerable opponent (No. 95 in red/white) who is near the net and partially on the ice, while others are engaged around them.
